title: Shared resonance combines micro-conscious entities into macro-conscious ones

statements.text: All physical entities resonate and all have some subjectivity, and resonating structures near each other reach a shared resonance when their coupling is strong enough. The conjecture is that shared resonance is what combines micro-conscious entities into a macro-conscious entity, whose boundaries depend on the velocity and frequency of the resonance chains connecting its parts.

sources.quote: Conjecture 1: Shared resonance is what leads to the combination of micro-conscious entities into macro-conscious entities
Axiom 2: All physical entities have some accompanying subjectivity/consciousness
